summary.intent: Consolidate four related pending todos into a single GSD phase: fix a self-bootstrap regression (#498 clobbering fresher folderTree state), remove redundant web folder-seeding (gated on that fix), route shared-folder writes through the SDK, and encrypt share itemName at rest (Phase 14 M1 security finding).
summary.outcome: Phase 48 was created, planned (6 plans across 3 waves), and Wave 1 was partially executed: the sequenceNumber guard fix landed and fixed one of two failing web-e2e specs, but a second root cause (loadBin treating a cold-cache null as 'empty' and destructively publishing an empty bin record) was diagnosed and fixed. The bin fix was staged and committed unsigned after 1Password SSH signing wedged; web-e2e re-dispatch is pending. Waves 2–3 have not yet run.

repo: web-e2e CI only auto-triggers on push to main (via ci-e2e.yml paths-filter), not on PRs — this is the structural gap that let the #498 regression land unverified.

web-e2e.yml supports workflow_dispatch with a ref input (ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}), enabling pre-merge isolated gate: `env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>`. No CI change needed.
The GSD branching_strategy: phase mode creates a new branch off origin/main from the current HEAD, not from a remote base — so it preserves local planning commits in the branch history.
markdownlint pre-commit hook skips .planning/ (prettier still normalizes those docs).
TypeORM migrations live in apps/api/src/migrations/; schema-push command is `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run`; API types regenerated with `pnpm api:generate`.
1Password SSH signing can wedge in unattended/AFK runs with 'failed to fill whole buffer' — disabling repo-local signing (git config commit.gpgsign false) is the recovery path.
The UQ_folder_ipns_user_ipns duplicate-key server error appears in passing tests too and is background noise, not from the self-bootstrap path.

code.finding: loadFolder had an unconditional folderTree.set() at ~385; the sequenceNumber guard was inserted at 378 (if existing.sequenceNumber >= resolved → keep existing) to prevent self-bootstrap from clobbering fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot.
ensureFolderLoaded short-circuit at :422 — must be kept intact; the guard in loadFolder must not re-trigger this path.
DFS child-check at :454 — must be preserved alongside the reconcile guard to avoid re-regressing #498.

loadBin treated a null from resolveIpnsRecord as 'bin is empty' and eagerly published an empty bin record. Null also occurs on a transient cold-cache miss right after page.reload(). Two concurrent loadBin calls (login fire-and-forget + BinBrowser mount) with no expectedSequenceNumber caused the API to unconditionally bump sequence and overwrite latestCid, destroying the real bin record so deleted items vanished after reload.
folder:updated event pattern — REQ-3's new sharedFolder:updated event should be modeled on this.
Write-back in useSharedWriteOps that becomes an event-fed projection in REQ-3; withConflictRetry is dropped because CAS moves into the SDK client.
Migration to clone for REQ-4 (itemName ECIES column). Pattern: additive nullable bytea column, no data UPDATE (zero-knowledge server).

workflow: GSD todo-grouping analysis: 'do together' (same branch, dependency-ordered) vs 'supersession' (one todo subsumes another but on different horizons) are distinct relationships requiring different handling.

Pattern mapper + planner (Opus) + checker (Sonnet) pipeline catches design forks before execution; the checker's VALIDATION.md per-task table gap is intentionally TBD and back-filled by gsd:validate-phase.
Sequential plan execution (no worktree isolation) is preferred over parallel worktrees for unattended/AFK runs — fewer failure modes, all commits land directly on the shared branch.
For AFK pipeline runs: sign commits when the signer is healthy, but pre-authorize unsigned fallback so the pipeline doesn't wedge. Flag unsigned commits in PR description for admin review.
Hard gate protocol: if web-e2e returns red, attempt one root-cause fix + re-dispatch before stopping; do not open a PR on a failing gate. Advance to simplify/validate/review/PR only after green.

friction: 1Password SSH signing wedged mid-run ('failed to fill whole buffer') during unattended executor commits, requiring unsigned fallback and mid-session signing config change.
web-e2e.yml only auto-triggers on main push, so #498's regression wasn't caught pre-merge — the structural CI gap that motivated adding the dispatch gate to REQ-1.
Stream idle timeout mid-session cut off an earlier parallel research fan-out (the initial 'fan out four parallel readers' attempt failed silently).

The #498 self-bootstrap fix introduced a second, distinct regression (bin-restore-after-reload) that was masked: the sequenceNumber guard fixed version-restore but loadBin's null-handling bug required separate diagnosis.

Two concurrent loadBin calls after reload (login fire-and-forget + BinBrowser mount) with no CAS guard caused a race that destroyed the bin record — hard to detect without faithful IPNS/IPFS fakes in tests.
